testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-percent-off-category-promotion-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify percent off category promotion functionality

scenario.summary: A registered user (the promotion's profile) signs in and checks that an automatic Percent Off Category promotion gives no discount on a product outside the category or on the eligible product at quantity 1, then applies once the eligible line is raised: discount = percent x subtotal, order total = subtotal - discount. No order is placed.
steps: Sign in with username/password (empty storage state) and empty the cart
Add the other-category product (sku2) at quantity 1, open the cart, check there is no discount; empty the cart
Add the eligible product (sku1) at quantity 1, open the cart, check there is no discount
Raise the eligible line (name1) to updatedQuantity, reload; check the quantity and the 'Discount (On Sub Total)' label
Read unit cost (> 0), subtotal, discount, order total: discount = discountAmount% x subtotal; order total = subtotal - discount
Empty the cart, check the empty-cart message, log out
stateChanges: Registered user's cart: products added, quantity raised, emptied at cleanup
The promotion is only read; no order is placed
assertions: No discount with only the other-category product
No discount with the eligible product at quantity 1
Eligible line quantity equals updatedQuantity; discount label 'Discount (On Sub Total)' visible
Discount close to discountAmount% of subtotal (precision 2)
Order total close to subtotal - discount (precision 2)
Empty cart message visible; sign-in link visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify percent off category promotion functionality'; spec note: AUTO 20% category promotion, signed-in user = the selected profile
Profile: sku1 z-2100012 (Schlage) and sku2 z-2100018 (Hillman) are active simple products
Promotion profile 'Retail Customer' = MaxwellsHardware's default registered profile (atstage rows), assumed to be the declared user's profile (USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED does not constrain profile)
allProfiles false: the export's non-selected-profile check is manual (not migrated); false keeps the promotion mapped to the named profile
Recorded discountAmount 20.00 and updatedQuantity 2 are role data of the promotion (discountAmount, minimumQuantity)

The discounted / not-discounted products are tied to the resolved promotion through their 'promotion' param, written as '@promotion.promoCode' (the promo code output of the promotion need in this test); the resolver cannot bind a param to another need's output yet (reported gap)
